main_text.p: Sed vitiis, quibus euertit Regna omnia, famam Polluit ille suam, polluit illeneam.
main_text.head: CAROLVS LOTHARINGIVS Cardinalis.
main_text.p: IAm fuor humanus Furias laffarat, inermes Torpuerant angues, torpuerantque faces, Cum te vis inimica bonis, Carle, edidit, vnus Profurius possis qui satis esse tribus.
main_text.head: MARGARITA REGINA NAVARRÆ.
main_text.p: ESte aliis videor fælix patre Rege, viróque, Et nato, & proauis edita sceptrigeris. Ast ego fœlicem, si sum, me iudico, rerum Quòd Dominus famulam me velit esse suam.
main_text.head: MARIA REGINA ANGLIÆ.
main_text.p: SVm Marie, male grata viro, male grata marito: Cœlo inuisa, mea pestis atrox patria. Nulla aberat labes: nisi quod adfuit addita custos Fida pudicitia forma maligna mea.
main_text.head: IN ELISABET. ANGLIÆ REG.
main_text.p: CVius imago Dea, facie lui lucet in vna, Temperie mixta, Iuno, Minerua, Venus? Est dea: quid dubitem? cui sic conspirat amicè Masculavis, hilaris gratia, celsius honos: Aut Dea si non est, Diua est quæ præsidet Anglis, Ingenio, vultu, moribus æqua Deis.
main_text.head: IN EANDEM.
main_text.p: QV a manus artificis tria sic confundit, vt vno Gratia, maiestas, & decor ore miscent?

page.notes: Initial letters I, S, C, Q are large woodcut-style initials, joined to their words. Some words in the printed scan are doubtful (e.g. "illeneam", "Ast", "sceptrigeris", "Vius") and may be printing errors or blurred letters; "Masculavis" reads as printed. Small marks at the left margin are not text.
